notes: STAGE 1 OF 4: QUICK CUT. Mon 26 Oct 2026 to Sun 17 Jan 2027, 12 weeks: 10 cutting weeks plus reset weeks 6 and 12. Start from the true baseline: 90.8 kg and 28.5% body fat (11 Sep). Expect 0.7–1.0 kg a week in cutting weeks, about 8 kg total, ending near 82–83 kg and 22–23% body fat. Roadmap. Stage 2, 18 Jan to about 11 Apr, 12 weeks: clean bulk with a small surplus and heavier lifting. Stage 3, 12 Apr to mid-July: second cut. Stage 4: hold or finish the cut through the end of summer. Honest expectation: a bulk between two cuts means about 14–15% body fat in mid-July and 11–12% by the end of summer. If a shredded mid-July matters more than the bulk, skip stage 2. Stage 1 is the same either way. Week 1 only: the pre-gym sandwich uses chicken breast 80 g cooked instead of tuna 100 g drained (pick it in the Sandwich protein swap). From week 2 it is tuna again. Rules. 1) Three gym days: Sat, Mon, Wed. Two is a pass. Never make up a session. Keep the lifts heavy. 2) One plan, same food every day. Everything is weighed and counted, coffee included. Tick every meal every day, including bad days. Logging stopped after 5 Oct, and that was the first sign. 3) Cardio is planned: 20 minutes of easy incline walking after each lift. Nothing else counts. Daily steps stay around 2,000. 4) Sleep 7 hours or more. 5) One planned flex meal a week, Friday dinner only. 6) Craving at night: water or Coke Zero, then wait 20 minutes. If still hungry, eat the next planned meal early; do not add extra food. 7) Weigh every morning; judge the 7-day average, not the day. Weeks 1 and 2 can read 1.5 kg or more lower from water. After that aim for 0.7–1.0 kg a week. 8) If the 7-day average falls less than 0.5 kg a week for 2 cutting weeks in a row after week 3, add one 30-minute easy cardio visit on Thursday. Food does not go lower. 9) If it falls more than 1.2 kg a week for 2 weeks in a row, add 50 g cooked rice to lunch. 10) Week 5 is where the last cut crashed. If energy is 2 out of 5 or lower, or hunger is 4 out of 5 or higher, on 3 days in one week, take the reset week early instead of skipping sessions. 11) Stage 1 ends on 17 Jan whatever the scale says. Do not extend it.

diet.name: Stage 1 quick cut — Kayy oats, Dina cottage cheese, one plan every day
diet.notes: One plan, same food every day, no carb cycling. Everything is counted, coffee included: 1676 kcal, protein 178 g, carbs 155 g, fat 36 g (about 42% protein, 37% carbs, 19% fat). Weigh dry oats before cooking; weigh chicken and rice cooked; tuna drained. Values used: Kayy high protein oats 372 kcal, 30 g protein, 61 g carbs, 1 g fat per 100 g (pack label as listed online). Dina Farms cottage cheese is ASSUMED at 100 kcal, 12 g protein, 3.5 g carbs, 4 g fat per 100 g because no label is published online. Check your tub and correct the plan if it differs. No sugar this stage. Coke Zero is free. One Red Bull Zero on gym days replaces coffee 2. Spray oil: 6 spritzes a day, not counted. Anything not written here is not eaten. This is a short, hard cut, so it ends on schedule: do not extend it and do not go lower. Reset weeks (6 and 12): breakfast oats 90 g instead of 50 g, lunch rice 180 g instead of 100 g, one extra small banana in the afternoon, dinner fino 80 g instead of 40 g. That is about +450 kcal a day. Friday dinner may be replaced by one planned flex meal of up to about 900 kcal, protein first, one plate, no leftovers.

training.name: Stage 1 — 3-day full body (Sat / Mon / Wed)
training.notes: Three evenings: Saturday, Monday, Wednesday. Sun, Tue, Thu, Fri are rest. A week with 2 sessions is a pass. A week with 3 is a good week. Never make up a missed session and never stack two sessions in a day. If Saturday is missed, Monday is the first session. If two sessions are missed in one week, do not change the plan; just do the next scheduled session. Every session is about 18–19 sets, 60 minutes of lifting plus the 20-minute walk. Stop every set with 1–2 reps in the tank. Hold the load until every set reaches the top of the rep range, then add 2.5–5 kg. Week 1 is a re-entry week after the break: 3 sets on the big lifts at the lighter weights written in the notes. Weeks 6 and 12 are reset weeks: 2 sets per exercise, same weights, and more food (see the diet notes). Keep the weights heavy through the whole cut; the goal is to arrive at the next stage with the same strength, not less. Cardio is planned, not left to chance: 20 minutes of easy incline walking after each lift, 3 times a week. You only walk between home, work, and the gym, so daily steps stay around 2,000 and are not part of the plan. If the 7-day average stalls after week 3, the first lever is one extra 30-minute easy cardio visit on Thursday; food does not go lower than the plan.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.notes: Top set 120 kg until you hit 6–7. Leave 1–2 reps in the tank. Week 1 only: 3 sets at about 105 kg.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.notes: Hold 80 kg until every set is 6–7. Week 1 only: 3 sets at 72.5 kg.

exercises.name: Chest supported row
exercises.notes: 70 kg. Add reps toward 10, then add 2.5–5 kg.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.notes: 65–75 kg. All 3 sets at 10–12 before any jump in weight.

exercises.name: Incline walk finisher
exercises.notes: Planned cardio. Easy incline, a pace where you can talk, 20 minutes after the last lift. It is the only cardio in the week and it is counted in the plan. Skip it only if you were too flat to start the session.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.notes: 70 kg until you hit 9–10 on every set, then +5 kg.

exercises.name: Leg press
